metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where I was just pointing and Valorant said ‘Go crazy, champ!’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just wing it and get 2 kills?
Enemy must’ve been doing their taxes mid-fight.
Click if your aim is more ‘guesswork’ than ‘pro play’!
Valorant logic: chaos wins again.

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
